# Trew North Accounting

> Trew North Accounting is a Melbourne-based accounting firm specialising in small business tax, bookkeeping, SMSF, and financial strategy. Led by Darren Trew CA, with over 25 years' experience helping Melbourne small business owners.

## About

Trew North Accounting serves ambitious small business owners in Melbourne and across Australia. The firm is based in Beaumaris, VIC 3193, and operates primarily online via Xero, video calls, and email.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**When is my tax return due?**  
For individuals lodging through a tax agent, the due date is generally 15 May of the following year. Business returns vary by entity type.

**What is a BAS?**  
A Business Activity Statement (BAS) reports GST, PAYG withholding, and other tax obligations to the ATO. Most GST-registered businesses lodge quarterly.

**Should my business register for GST?**  
You must register for GST once your annual turnover reaches or is expected to reach $75,000 ($150,000 for non-profit organisations). Voluntary registration is available below this threshold.

**What accounting software does Trew North recommend?**  
Xero is the primary recommendation for most small businesses — cloud-based, integrates with hundreds of apps, and gives real-time visibility into finances.

**Is an SMSF right for me?**  
An SMSF is generally suitable for those with a super balance of $200,000 or more who want direct control over their investments and are willing to meet trustee obligations.
